librarySource: Existing frozen repository-authored construction results plus the previously user-provided 21-degree prescription. Source files, SHA-256, usage authority and acquisition costs are recorded; no web scraping or automatic commercial-corpus ingestion.
controlledCase: A recorded qualified project-authored 3-element F/8 full10 source with +0.0005/mm applied to the query front curvature; this is a deliberate retrieval sanity case, not a held-out generalization/new-design benchmark.
historicalCases: Original M2 source plans and inherited acquisition work, with unchanged fields, wavelengths, materials/profile/axial permissions, protected/fixed planes, element bounds, apertures, targets and manufacturing limits.
inheritedInputAcquisition: Frozen M0/M1 preparation cost is subtracted from online budget and added to both arms' end-to-end totals; original provided inputs have no new preparation dispatch, but their original design cost is not assumed known.
offlineLibraryCosts: Source acquisition cost deduplicated by source-document SHA-256; original 21-degree creation cost unknown; measured library indexing separately. Both remain separate from warm online query cost; no free cold-start or general speed claim.
fixedArm: M2 parent-only recovery/competition, one parent, one branch, no structure operation, original final validation; each query's complete options are frozen under inputs/.
retrievalTransform: Use scale 1 if source EFL is already inside the original focal tolerance; otherwise uniform Core dimensional scaling. Anchor the stop, retain original task reference/stop/image/settings and ordinal face apertures; honor original material/profile/axial/protection bounds. Source descriptor roundoff tolerance is 1e-12 and affects index checking only; actual Core descriptor controls transfer and original physical thresholds stay strict.
finalAcceptance: Unchanged TopologyValidator Core CPU/double: original fields sampled21, Gaussian10x32 plus center+32 rim checks, all positive-weight wavelengths, original first-order and manufacturing checks.
qualification: Only completed original assessment with all gates passed qualifies. Retrieved historical prescriptions and original-input reuse are distinct from new generated designs. Incomplete/failed candidates retain evidence; working seeds must satisfy the unchanged original first-order/manufacturing boundary.
independentVerification: Every saved content hash, all source receipts, fixed settings/apertures/permissions, per-entry and total work/budgets, qualification and retained-seed boundary; independently replay every distinct saved original assessment. Verifier replay cost is separate.
execution: One bounded background CPU run at a time, nested parallelism suppressed; no desktop interaction, no GPU claim. Five seed labels are engineering comparisons; retrieval itself is deterministic. Report all outcomes and actual costs without a universal-success or acceleration claim.
